messages.text: a friend asked when he claims his hex, is it before you buy or when you buy or after you buy?

Sounds like the Wingbits side of it rather than the hardware — hex claiming happens on the network once you're set up, not at our checkout. Buying the 4DSKY doesn't lock you to a hex.

Is he running Wingbits with it? I'll point you at the right answer for that.
but dont we reserve one so noone else can claim it in the meantime or am i mistaken?
Handed to the team · Cannot confirm whether a purchase reserves a hex; won't guess.

I don't want to guess on that one — I can't confirm that a purchase holds a hex for you, and a wrong answer there costs you the spot.

I've put it to the team with your email; they pick it up tomorrow at 10am ET and the answer comes to you by email.

Understood — the 4DSKY hardware itself. Same answer though: I can't confirm any hex reservation tied to buying one, and I won't invent one. That's with the team now and lands in your inbox tomorrow.

Meanwhile, two antenna variants exist — US, and EU+NZ. Where would it be running?
US, I will talk to him tomorrow, i think hes buying it either way so its all good thanks
Before you go, one thing: are you looking at a 4DSKY for yourself too, or just helping him decide?
i have one i just cant recall because i bought mine back in january

Makes sense — January's a long way back, and that side of it changed since.

What made you go with the 4DSKY back then?
I learned of it through Hedera its an interesting vision they have and the tech is top notch, vision seems well thought out
Good reason to come in. What's kept you with it since January — the network side, or the hardware just running quietly in the background?
both but the network, seems to be evolving (to me anyway) with talk of connecting all types of sensors, not just airsquitters

That's useful — thanks for telling me. That's three from me, so I'll leave you be.

The hex question is with the team and the answer reaches your email tomorrow.
